const stored = {};
function nonliteral({ outer: { value = 1 } } = { outer: stored }) {
  return value;
}

function pair({ outer: { first = 1, second = 2 } = {} } = { outer: { second: 4 } }) {
  return first + second;
}
pair({ outer: { first: 1, second: 3 } });
pair({ outer: {} });

function tuple({ outer: [one = 1, two = 'ok'] = [] } = { outer: [] }) {
  return [one, two];
}
tuple({ outer: [1, 'ok'] });

const arrow = ({ outer: { value = 1 } = {} } = { outer: {} }) => value;
const expression = function ({ outer: { value = 1 } = {} } = { outer: {} }) {
  return value;
};
const method = {
  read({ outer: { value = 1 } = {} } = { outer: {} }) {
    return value;
  },
};
console.log(arrow(), expression(), method.read());

function missingTupleBinding([value] = []) { return value; }
function missingFirstBinding([value, fallback = 1] = []) { return [value, fallback]; }
function missingAfterValue([present, missing] = [1]) { return [present, missing]; }
const tupleSource = [] as [];
function missingFromStoredTuple([value] = tupleSource) { return value; }
function missingNestedBinding({values: [value] = []} = {}) { return value; }
function annotatedNestedTuple({values: [value] = []}: {values?: [number?]}) { return value; }
function choose(callback: (value?: [number?]) => number | undefined) { return callback(); }
choose(([value] = []) => value);
function tupleWithValue([[value = 2]] = [[1]]) { return value; }
tupleWithValue([[]]);
function spreadObject({outer: {value = 2}} = {outer: {...{value: 1}}}) { return value; }
spreadObject({outer: {}});
function defaultedOuter({outer: {value = 2} = {}} = {outer: {value: 1}}) { return value; }
defaultedOuter({outer: {}});
